entries.text: If you don't believe me, ask her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Drop it!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Get away from her, Pam.
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: This isn't gonna work. You can't be in here.
entries.speaker: Pam

entries.text: Drop it now!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You drop it.
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: Listen to me, Bernard--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You get her out of here!
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: You get her out of here. You're dooming her by doing this. You're making her live this day over and over again-- her, you, me. All of us!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What the hell are you talking about?
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: Every day you die in here, and every day it starts all over again. You can't want this for her. It's hell!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Hell? I'm doing this for her.
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: Listen to him, Bernard.
entries.speaker: Pam

entries.text: Put your damn gun down!
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: Put your gun down, Scully. Trust me. It's the only way to get out of here. You gotta put your gun down and let them out. He's got a bomb.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ gun hits floor ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Come on, Bernard. Let's go.
entries.speaker: Pam

entries.text: [ siren wailing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You son of a bitch!
entries.speaker: Bernard

entries.text: No!
entries.speaker: Pam

entries.text: [ gunshot ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ labored breathing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: This is agent Dana Scully with the FBI
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: This never happened before.
entries.speaker: Pam

entries.text: [ ringing ] yeah?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, it's me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm late again, aren't I, Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, not yet. But Skinner wants to see us in his office as soon as possible. He's asking for our report on the robbery yesterday.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'll be there in an hour.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'd like to hear it too.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, you were there, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's not what I mean. You still won't explain what happened yesterday-- how you knew that Bernard oates was strapped with explosives.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Call it a feeling.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And it was also a feeling that he had an accomplice waiting in the car?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I don't think she was an accomplice. I think she was just trying to get away.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'll be there in an hour.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ beeps ]
entries.speaker: Sound
